# QnALog 1.7.0

QnALog now concentrates on recording, transcription and the knowledge organized from recordings. This release removes several presentation features, merges overlapping actions, and adds further protection for recordings.

## Removed

- **Minutes Board** view and the "Open Notes Board" command. Use the sidebar note list or Obsidian's file explorer.
- **Semantic Canvas** generation, **HTML / PDF reports** and **email drafts (.eml)**, including the note-list Export submenu and the report settings.
- The command **"AI: Polish Current Selection or Entire Note"**.
- **To-do cards and the to-do wall.** Confirmed to-dos are still added as tasks under "To-do" in today's daily note with a link to the source note (requires the Daily notes core plugin).
- **Watched folders outside the vault.** The watched folder must be inside the vault; if it is not, a notice is shown at startup and the folder's files are not touched.
- The **append note layout** switch. All notes use one layout: organized body on top, raw segments folded below.
- The command "Reorganize This Note (Using Speaker Names)" and the sidebar **Preference** picker. Speaker names are applied by every re-generate action; preferences moved into the submenus below.

## Changed

- The note-list menu has two re-generate actions, each with a mode submenu (the note's own mode first) and optional preferences:
  - **Reorganize** rewrites the note using its own mode. The current note is saved to the hidden `.versions` folder first; if that save fails, the note is not changed.
  - **Save as new version** (formerly "Generate derived version") creates a separate note. **Clean copy** is in this submenu.
- After failed segments are transcribed again, an organized note is reorganized in place instead of receiving an extra derived note. Failed-then-retried imports are also organized in place.
- The Distill tab in the sidebar is unchanged in behavior; its code moved out of the main sidebar view.
- The `00:00`-style recording links in a note's raw transcript section are now clickable and play the recording, in reading view and live preview. Note files are not changed.
- Notes no longer get an index data card. Related notes and topic overview cards compute it from the note's current text, so they no longer use outdated cards. An old card is removed from a note the next time QnALog writes that note; other notes are not changed.

## Recordings and reliability

- Recording segments, short recordings and recovered recordings are kept unless the saved master audio has been read back and verified, or audio levels prove the recording is silent. Recording audio is kept after transcription retries.
- Transcription retries recover from zero-byte or unreadable segment cache files. Playback links for retried segments point to the right recording.
- A hidden snapshot is saved before AI organization rewrites a note. Edits made while the first AI organization is running are kept.
- A whole-file "no words" result is treated as a blank import. Text containing `$&`, `$'` and similar sequences is written literally in notes and prompts.
- Switching versions keeps the selected knowledge. The ready status is shown correctly when queue recovery is paused.

## User impact

- The settings schema version is unchanged. Settings for removed features (report folders and branding, email draft folders, to-do card folder, note layout switch) are dropped the next time settings are saved. API keys, service configuration, prompts, paths and device choices are kept.
- Existing notes, folders, `.canvas` maps, HTML reports, PDFs, `.eml` drafts, to-do card files and `.base` files are not moved, rewritten or deleted.
- A workspace that still has a Minutes Board tab shows Obsidian's placeholder for a missing view; close the tab. Hotkeys bound to removed commands need to be set again.
- Branch builds installed for testing are labelled `x.y.(z+1)-dev.*`, so BRAT and Obsidian do not replace them with the current release.
